registry.name: rimo-email-boocar-account-notice-email
registry.title: boocar 公务车账号通知
registry.descriptionEn: Welcome company administrators with fleet account details, a sign-in link, and the steps to get started.
registry.description: 向企业管理员发送公务车账号开通通知，集中说明账号信息、登录入口与开始使用的步骤。

registry.name: rimo-email-boocar-branch-admin-notice-email
registry.title: boocar 分公司账号通知
registry.descriptionEn: Notify branch administrators that their account is ready, with company, branch, sign-in, and management scope details.
registry.description: 通知分公司管理员账号已开通，说明所属企业、分公司、登录方式及可管理的业务范围。

registry.name: rimo-email-enterprise-branch-admin-notice-email
registry.title: 企业分公司管理员通知
registry.descriptionEn: Give newly authorized branch administrators their account details and sign-in link to start managing their branch.
registry.description: 向企业指定的分公司管理员说明授权结果、账号信息与登录入口，帮助接手本分公司的日常管理。

registry.name: rimo-email-enterprise-contract-notice-email
registry.title: 企业签约账号通知
registry.descriptionEn: Send company administrators their sign-in details and a guide to the services available under their agreement.
registry.description: 企业账号开通后，向管理员提供登录信息与已开放服务的使用指引，方便查看签约内容并开始使用。

registry.name: rimo-email-notification-messages
registry.title: 通知消息
registry.descriptionEn: Browse email and SMS templates by use case. Review summaries, subjects, and content, or open a full email preview.
registry.description: 按业务场景查找 Email 与短信模板，查看通知名称、摘要、主题及正文，并进入完整信件预览。

registry.name: rimo-verification-email
registry.title: 验证码邮件
registry.descriptionEn: Preview the email used to verify an address, including tenant identity, verification code, instructions, and security notice.
registry.description: 展示用户验证邮箱时收到的验证码邮件，保留租户标识、验证码、操作提示与安全说明。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-approval-setting
registry.title: 预约审批设定
registry.descriptionEn: Set whether fleet reservations require approval for each branch, within the administrator’s organizational scope.
registry.description: 按分公司设定公务车预约是否需要审批，明确员工提交后的处理方式，并按管理员的组织权限限制配置范围。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-branch-company-management
registry.title: 分公司管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage company branches, administrators, and available stations. Create, edit, and enable branches for staff, vehicle access, and reporting.
registry.description: 维护企业分公司的基本资料、管理员与可用据点。支持新增、编辑和启停，为员工归属、车辆使用及统计提供组织依据。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-car-use-management
registry.title: 车辆使用范围
registry.descriptionEn: Assign employees or departments to company vehicles and review branch ownership and access rules for dedicated fleet reservations.
registry.description: 为公务车辆配置可使用的员工或部门，查看车辆所属分公司及授权范围，控制专用车辆的预约资格。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-channel-ticket-batch-detail
registry.title: 企业租车券批次详情
registry.descriptionEn: Review your company’s voucher batches, distribution, and usage. Follow related orders and settlement charges down to each voucher.
registry.description: 查看本企业租车券活动的批次信息、发券与使用进度，核对关联订单和结算费用，追踪每张券的使用结果。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-channel-ticket-batches
registry.title: 企业合作通路租车券
registry.descriptionEn: Submit voucher campaigns with rental periods and recipient lists or quantities, then track approvals, issued batches, and orders.
registry.description: 合作企业提交租车券活动申报，维护用车时段、名单或数量，并查询正式批次、用券订单与审批进度。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-contract-quotas
registry.title: 合约配额管理
registry.descriptionEn: Review fleet contract quotas, branch allocations, and assigned vehicles. Arrange transfers between company contracts and track quota usage.
registry.description: 查看公务车合约的可用配额、分公司分配及车辆绑定，在同企业合约间安排车辆转移，追踪配额的使用情况。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-corporate-login
registry.title: 企业端登录
registry.descriptionEn: A company administrator sign-in flow with account and password fields, validation feedback, and access to the fleet workspace.
registry.description: 企业管理员通过业务账号进入公务车后台。页面展示账号与密码输入、校验反馈和登录后的业务入口。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-dashboard
registry.title: 公务车仪表板
registry.descriptionEn: An overview of staff, fleet assets, orders, trip duration, and utilization, with branch trends and rankings to understand fleet usage.
registry.description: 总览企业员工、车辆、订单、用车时长与使用率，按分公司查看趋势和排名，帮助了解公务车的投入与使用情况。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-department-management
registry.title: 部门管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage departments and supervisors within each branch to support staff assignments, reservation approvals, vehicle access, and usage reporting.
registry.description: 维护分公司内的部门与主管信息，为员工归属、预约审批、车辆使用授权及部门用车统计建立组织基础。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-dispatch-schedule
registry.title: 车辆调度排程
registry.descriptionEn: Explore reservations and actual occupancy on a vehicle timeline. Find available periods and conflicts, including trips booked by other branches.
registry.description: 沿车辆与时间轴查看公务车预约和实际占用，定位空闲时段与冲突；跨分公司的用车记录仍显示在对应车辆排程中。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-employee-management
registry.title: 员工管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage approved employees, review organization and employment status, and update branches, departments, or bulk settings within your access scope.
registry.description: 管理已审核通过的企业员工，查询组织归属、基础资料及在职状态，并按权限调整分公司、部门和批量业务设置。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-employee-review
registry.title: 员工申请审核
registry.descriptionEn: Review requests to join the company, check employee details and branch assignments, approve or reject applications, and inspect review history.
registry.description: 审核员工加入企业的申请，核对申请资料与分公司归属，处理通过或驳回，并查看审核记录。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-official-car-bill
registry.title: 公务车账单
registry.descriptionEn: Review fleet contract billing periods, quota fees, payment progress, and transfer details for new subscriptions and renewals.
registry.description: 按公务车合约查看账期、配额费用、付款进度与汇款明细，核对新增及续费产生的企业应付账款。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-official-order-add
registry.title: 新增公务订单
registry.descriptionEn: Book a company vehicle for an employee. Select the driver, station, vehicle, and period, then check eligibility and approval requirements.
registry.description: 由企业管理员代员工预约公务车，选择用车人、据点、车辆与时段，核对可用范围及审批要求后提交。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-official-order
registry.title: 公务订单管理
registry.descriptionEn: Find employee fleet reservations, approvals, and trips by status or organization, with vehicle and pickup and return details.
registry.description: 查询员工的公务车预约、审批和实际用车记录，按状态与组织定位订单，查看行程、车辆及取还车详情。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-official-vehicle-add
registry.title: 新增公务车
registry.descriptionEn: Create a company vehicle record with model, registration, ownership, and usage details for reservations and fleet administration.
registry.description: 建立公务车辆档案，填写车型、证照和车辆基础资料，配置资产归属与使用信息，为后续预约和车辆管理提供依据。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-official-vehicle-reminders
registry.title: 清洁保养提醒
registry.descriptionEn: Review cleaning and maintenance reminders against each vehicle’s baseline, record completed work, and track outstanding maintenance needs.
registry.description: 根据车辆保养基线与提醒规则查看待处理事项，记录清洁保养完成情况，持续跟踪公务车辆的维护需求。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-official-vehicles
registry.title: 公务车辆管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage company vehicles, asset branches, parking stations, contract quotas, and usage, including the conditions that make vehicles available to book.
registry.description: 集中管理公务车辆资料、资产分公司、停放据点、合约配额及使用量，查看车辆状态并维护可预约条件。

registry.name: rimo-enterprise-time-share-orders
registry.title: 企业分时租赁订单
registry.descriptionEn: A read-only view of your company’s round-trip and one-way rentals, with driver, itinerary, vehicle, and cost details for reconciliation.
registry.description: 只读查询本企业的同站租还与甲租乙还订单，查看用车人、行程、车辆及费用信息，便于企业核对用车记录。

registry.name: rimo-tutorial-index
registry.title: 公务车教程目录
registry.descriptionEn: Browse fleet tutorials by role and chapter to find where a feature lives, how to use it, and what to check along the way.
registry.description: 按角色与章节浏览公务车操作教程，快速找到对应功能的进入路径、操作步骤与注意事项。

registry.name: rimo-tutorial-documentation
registry.title: 公务车教程文档版
registry.descriptionEn: Read fleet tutorials in a documentation layout with role-based chapters, navigation paths, steps, and illustrations.
registry.description: 用文档式目录阅读公务车角色与操作章节，结合路径、步骤和图示理解每项功能，支持连续阅读与章节定位。

registry.name: rimo-tutorial-editor
registry.title: 公务车教程维护
registry.descriptionEn: Edit fleet tutorial roles, chapters, navigation paths, steps, and screenshot notes in the shared structure used by each reading layout.
registry.description: 维护公务车教程的角色、章节、路径、步骤与截图说明，统一编辑标题、简介及更新时间，供各阅读版本共用。

registry.name: rimo-tutorial
registry.title: 公务车操作教程
registry.descriptionEn: Role-based fleet instructions for company administrators, branch administrators, and employees, covering setup through reservation and use.
registry.description: 面向企业管理员、分公司管理员与员工提供公务车操作指引，按角色查看从配置到预约用车的具体步骤。

registry.name: rimo-mobile-channel-ticket-app-compatible
registry.title: 租车券预约：现有流程适配
registry.descriptionEn: Add voucher booking to the existing rental flow, keeping period, station, and vehicle selection within the voucher’s permitted scope.
registry.description: 在现有租车流程中接入租车券，保留时段、据点与车辆选择，并根据券的适用范围限定可预约内容。

registry.name: rimo-mobile-channel-ticket-app
registry.title: 租车券预约 APP
registry.descriptionEn: Start a round-trip booking from an available voucher or redemption code, with eligible rental periods, stations, and vehicles.
registry.description: 会员从我的租车券或兑换码进入预约，查看券的可用状态，按指定时段、据点和车辆范围完成同站租还预订。

registry.name: rimo-channel-ticket-applications
registry.title: 租车券申报审批
registry.descriptionEn: Review partner voucher campaigns by company, status, or distribution method. Check periods and recipients, assign stations, and approve or reject. Approval creates the issued batch.
registry.description: 审核合作企业提交的租车券活动申报。按企业、状态与发券方式查找记录，核对用车时段、名单或数量，绑定据点并通过或驳回；审批通过后生成正式批次。

registry.name: rimo-channel-ticket-batch-detail
registry.title: 租车券批次详情
registry.descriptionEn: Inspect campaign inventory risk, vouchers, orders, charges, and activity. Enable or suspend the batch, add recipients, or issue more vouchers.
registry.description: 查看活动批次、库存风险、租车券状态与关联订单，核对费用和操作记录，并处理批次启停、追加名单及新增券。

registry.name: rimo-channel-ticket-batches
registry.title: 合作通路租车券
registry.descriptionEn: Create or approve partner voucher batches for round-trip rentals. Set eligible periods, stations, and distribution methods, then track issuance and use.
registry.description: 管理合作企业的同站租还活动批次，直接创建或由申报审批生成，配置指定时段、据点与发券方式，追踪发放和使用进度。

registry.name: rimo-corporate-detail
registry.title: 企业详情
registry.descriptionEn: A company record combining contacts, subscribed services, and monthly billing with fleet quotas, staff, orders, and invoices.
registry.description: 集中查看企业基本资料、联系人、签约服务与月结设置，关联公务车合约配额、员工、订单及账单，了解企业的服务使用情况。

registry.name: rimo-corporate-login
registry.title: 企业服务登录
registry.descriptionEn: A company customer sign-in screen with credential fields, validation messages, and feedback when entering the service workspace.
registry.description: 展示企业客户进入服务平台的账号登录流程，包含凭据输入、校验提示与进入业务后台的反馈。

registry.name: rimo-corporates
registry.title: 企业客户管理
registry.descriptionEn: Maintain company identifiers, contacts, and business accounts, configure subscribed services and plans, and find customers by status.
registry.description: 维护企业名称、统一编号、联系人与业务账号，配置签约服务和方案，按状态查找客户并进入企业详情。

registry.name: rimo-dashboard
registry.title: 综合仪表板
registry.descriptionEn: An operating overview of members, companies, fleet status, today’s orders, and estimated revenue, with recent trends and exception alerts.
registry.description: 总览会员与企业规模、车队状态、今日订单及预估收入，结合近期趋势和异常提醒，掌握当前营运情况。

registry.name: rimo-dispatch
registry.title: 车辆排程看板
registry.descriptionEn: View bookings, provisional assignments, and vehicle locks on a timeline. Spot conflicts and open slots, then move into manual dispatch.
registry.description: 沿时间轴查看车辆订单占用、预分配与硬锁，识别排程冲突和可用空档，并进入人工派车及调度处理。

registry.name: rimo-employees
registry.title: 平台业务账户管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage business accounts for operators, rental companies, stores, and stations, including departments, roles, contacts, and active status.
registry.description: 管理营运人员及车行、门市、据点的业务账号，维护部门、角色、联系方式和启停状态，明确各账号的业务归属。

registry.name: rimo-login
registry.title: 营运后台登录
registry.descriptionEn: An operator sign-in flow with account and password entry, validation and error feedback, and access to the organization’s workspace.
registry.description: 营运人员通过业务账号登录后台，填写账号与密码，查看校验和异常提示后进入所属组织的业务工作区。

registry.name: rimo-marketing
registry.title: 行销方案管理
registry.descriptionEn: Build promotions around customer eligibility, time, location, vehicle group, and rental period. Manage priorities, discounts, deductions, and fixed prices.
registry.description: 按客户资格、时段、据点、车组与租期配置优惠，维护方案优先级及折扣、直减、一口价规则，控制优惠在租车流程中的适用范围。

registry.name: rimo-member-detail
registry.title: 会员详情
registry.descriptionEn: Review member identity, contacts, qualifications, eligible vehicles, and current plan alongside orders, transactions, points, and review history.
registry.description: 集中查看会员身份、联系方式、证件资质、可用载具与当前方案，关联订单、交易、积分及审核历史，支持完整追踪会员记录。

registry.name: rimo-member-review
registry.title: 资质认证审核
registry.descriptionEn: Find applications by date, channel, and review status. Check identity, licence, and selfie evidence, then record approvals, rejections, or risk decisions.
registry.description: 按提交时间、渠道与审核状态查找会员，核对身份、驾照和自拍资料，处理通过、驳回及高风险记录并保留审核历史。

registry.name: rimo-members
registry.title: 个人会员管理
registry.descriptionEn: Find members by contact details, plan, company relationship, or account status, then open their full identity and rental history.
registry.description: 查询个人会员的联系资料、等级方案、企业关系与账户状态，快速定位会员并查看完整身份及用车记录。

registry.name: rimo-membership-plans
registry.title: 客户等级方案
registry.descriptionEn: Configure customer tiers, billing cycles, and benefits, with default, recommended, and visibility settings for membership and targeted promotions.
registry.description: 配置客户等级、收费周期与权益，维护默认、推荐和展示状态，为个人会员权益及企业专属行销匹配提供方案依据。

registry.name: rimo-new-order-one-way
registry.title: 新增甲租乙还订单
registry.descriptionEn: Create a one-way rental for a customer. Select booking identity, pickup and return stations, vehicle, and period, then review prices and promotions.
registry.description: 代客户创建异地还车订单，选择本次身份、取车及可还据点、具体车辆与租期，匹配价格和优惠后核对费用并提交。

registry.name: rimo-new-order-same-station
registry.title: 新增同站租还订单
registry.descriptionEn: Create a round-trip reservation with a personal or company identity, station, vehicle, and period, then review services, promotions, and charges.
registry.description: 代客户建立同站租还预约，选择个人或企业身份、据点、具体车辆与时段，配置服务和优惠，核对费用后提交订单。

registry.name: rimo-new-order
registry.title: 新增门市租车订单
registry.descriptionEn: Create a store rental from customer and pickup and return details. Choose a vehicle group and extras, apply promotions, and review preauthorization or monthly billing.
registry.description: 从客户身份、取还门市和时间开始，选择车组与增值服务，应用行销及抵扣，完成费用试算后以预授权或企业月结方式创建订单。

registry.name: rimo-official-vehicle-contracts
registry.title: 公务用车合约管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage fleet contracts with company and payer details, billing cycles, quotas, and charge periods, including termination and vehicle reassignment.
registry.description: 建立和维护企业公务车合约，查看用车企业、代付方、计费周期、车辆配额与收费期间，并处理合约终止和车辆改绑。

registry.name: rimo-order-detail
registry.title: 订单详情
registry.descriptionEn: Follow itinerary, customer, vehicle, dispatch, and funds in one place. Handle pickup, return, extensions, transfers, and exceptions with charge and audit details.
registry.description: 在一个页面追踪订单行程、客户与车辆、派车状态及资金情况，处理取还车、续租、转单和异常，并核对费用、交易与审计记录。

registry.name: rimo-permissions-grouped
registry.title: 权限管理：业务分组
registry.descriptionEn: Configure role permissions by business line and shared capability, with grouped menu, page, and action scopes and clear save and reset controls.
registry.description: 按业务线与共用功能分组配置角色权限，查看菜单、页面和操作范围，支持集中选择、保存与重置。

registry.name: rimo-permissions
registry.title: 权限管理
registry.descriptionEn: Maintain business roles and organization scopes. Configure menus, business lines, and actions in a permission tree, then save or restore settings.
registry.description: 维护业务角色及组织归属，按权限树配置菜单、业务线和操作范围，核对变更后保存或恢复原配置。

registry.name: rimo-pricing
registry.title: 动态调价策略
registry.descriptionEn: Review daily rates by store and vehicle group, schedule future price changes, and check their scope and results within your pricing permissions.
registry.description: 查看和维护门市车组的标准日租金，预设未来统一调价，并按权限控制改价、查看生效范围及调整结果。

registry.name: rimo-rental-companies
registry.title: 车行管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage rental company records, contacts, and operating status to establish vehicle ownership, store organization, and dispatch boundaries.
registry.description: 维护车行基础资料、联系人与经营状态，明确车辆资产和经营归属，为门市组织及同车行调度建立边界。

registry.name: rimo-service-products
registry.title: 基础产品定价
registry.descriptionEn: Combine vehicle models into rentable product groups and set standard prices and mileage rules for store rental quotes and charges.
registry.description: 将车型组合为可销售的产品组，配置车组标准价格和里程规则，为门市租车报价与费用计算提供基础。

registry.name: rimo-services
registry.title: 增值服务管理
registry.descriptionEn: Configure optional rental insurance, equipment, and services with eligibility, pricing, and display details for selection during booking.
registry.description: 维护租车附加保险、设备与人工服务，配置适用范围、费用和展示信息，供创建订单时选择并计入报价。

registry.name: rimo-settings
registry.title: 租赁业务规则
registry.descriptionEn: Manage store rental transaction, dispatch, billing, and fulfillment rules. Unlock a group to edit, save a recorded revision, or cancel to restore it.
registry.description: 按交易、派车、计费和履约管理门市租赁规则，解锁指定规则组后编辑，保存版本与操作记录，取消时恢复原配置。

registry.name: rimo-stations
registry.title: 据点管理
registry.descriptionEn: Find parking stations by rental company and store. Maintain location details and service capabilities through station and rental-mode views.
registry.description: 按车行和门市查询实体停车据点，维护位置资料及各租赁模式的服务能力，分别查看据点总览与模式配置。

registry.name: rimo-store-orders
registry.title: 门市租赁订单
registry.descriptionEn: Find store and authorized self-service rentals by status, customer, or itinerary, with access to pickup, return, extension, settlement, and exception handling.
registry.description: 查询门市租车及获授权的自助订单，按状态、客户和行程筛选，快速进入取还车、续租、结算与异常处理。

registry.name: rimo-stores
registry.title: 门市管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage rental company stores, opening hours, contacts, and staffed pickup and return services, linked to their parking stations.
registry.description: 维护车行下的门市资料、营业安排、联系人及人工交还车服务，关联停车据点，建立客户服务与履约组织。

registry.name: rimo-system-rules
registry.title: 系统通用参数
registry.descriptionEn: Configure membership policies, operations, holidays, notifications, and AI model connections in groups with explicit edit, save, and cancel actions.
registry.description: 集中配置会员策略、运维、日历假日、推送通知与 AI 模型接入参数，按规则组解锁编辑、保存或取消。

registry.name: rimo-tbox-management
registry.title: 车机设定中心
registry.descriptionEn: Review telematics devices assigned to the operator, inspect device and vehicle links, and maintain permitted settings and usage status.
registry.description: 查询分配给营运商的车机，查看设备资料和车辆绑定，维护允许的设备设定并追踪车机的使用状态。

registry.name: rimo-time-share-orders
registry.title: 分时租赁订单
registry.descriptionEn: Browse round-trip and one-way rentals for personal and company customers, with vehicle, itinerary, status, and payment details for fulfillment.
registry.description: 按同站租还与甲租乙还查询分时订单，区分个人和企业用车，查看车辆、行程、状态及资金信息并进入履约处理。

registry.name: rimo-vehicle-console
registry.title: 车辆控制台
registry.descriptionEn: A vehicle console for cars and micro EVs with live telematics, location, configured control actions, command receipts, and history.
registry.description: 集中查看汽车与微电车的车辆摘要、实时车机资料及地图位置，执行已配置的控车操作并追踪指令回执与历史。

registry.name: rimo-vehicle-groups
registry.title: 车型组管理
registry.descriptionEn: Manage vehicle makes, models, years, types, and feature tags, with photos and brand records used when creating vehicle profiles.
registry.description: 维护车辆的品牌、型号、年款、载具类型与规格标签，管理展示照片和品牌资料，供建立车辆档案时选择。

registry.name: rimo-vehicle-status-list
registry.title: 车辆速查表
registry.descriptionEn: Scan the fleet by organization, vehicle type, and attention status, with live conditions, exception tags, and links to the console, map, and history.
registry.description: 按组织、车型和关注状态快速筛查车队，查看实时车况及异常标签，并进入车辆控制台、地图和历史记录。

registry.name: rimo-vehicle-transfer
registry.title: 车辆调拨管理
registry.descriptionEn: Review vehicle locations and service status, then arrange station moves or transfers between service types with destination and eligibility checks.
registry.description: 查看车辆当前据点与服务状态，批量安排同业务据点调整或跨服务类型调拨，核对目标据点和车辆适用范围。

registry.name: rimo-vehicles
registry.title: 车辆档案库
registry.descriptionEn: Maintain plates, VINs, models, documents, and telematics links in a vehicle record separating ownership, current location, and service type.
registry.description: 集中维护车牌、VIN、车型、证照和车机绑定，分别记录资产车行、当前位置与服务类型，形成完整车辆档案。

registry.name: rimo-war-room
registry.title: 战情分析看板
registry.descriptionEn: Analyze revenue, rental trends, and fleet status by business line and period, comparing models, stations, channels, and risk indicators.
registry.description: 按业务线和周期分析营收、出租趋势与车辆状态，比较车型及站点表现，结合订单、渠道和风险数据定位营运变化。

registry.name: rimo-workbench
registry.title: 工作台首页
registry.descriptionEn: Start the day with tasks, fleet and revenue summaries, asset exceptions, announcements, and shortcuts to common operating workflows.
registry.description: 集中呈现今日待办、车队与收入概览、资产异常和最新公告，提供常用功能入口，帮助营运人员开始一天的工作。
